title: santolina chamaecyparissus var. squarrosa
intro: Santolina chamaecyparissus var. squarrosa, commonly known as Woolly Gray Santolina, is a perennial shrub that belongs to the aster family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat a variety of health issues, including digestive problems, respiratory issues, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The health benefits of Woolly Gray Santolina include reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and soothing irritated skin. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties.
